exposure: Piperonyl butoxide (PBO) administered orally at 50, 100, and 200 mg/kg/day
outcome: Maternal toxicity (decreased defecation, body weight loss)
cohort: The study participants were inseminated New Zealand White rabbits randomly assigned to a control group and three treatment groups of 16 does each.
finding: Although maternal toxicity was apparent at higher dose levels of Piperonyl butoxide (100 and 200 mg/kg/day), neither fetotoxicity nor teratogenicity were observed in rabbits at dose levels as high as 200 mg/kg/day.
gest_age: Treatment occurred on gestation days 7-19, with evaluation on gestation day 29.
